name: privacy
title: Privacy: export and delete
description: Data portability and the right to be forgotten: users download everything they own as JSON and delete their account; per resource delete, anonymize or keep; admin routes for support requests; optional grace period.
docs:
Export: GET /api/auth/me/export (a JSON download). Delete: DELETE /api/auth/me { password }.
Admins: POST /api/admin/users/:id/export, DELETE /api/admin/users/:id, POST /api/admin/users/:id/cancel-deletion.
Per resource on account deletion (default 'delete'): resource('post', { onOwnerDelete: 'anonymize', personalFields: ['authorName'], fields })
or in calm.config.js: blocks: { privacy: { resources: { invoice: 'keep' }, graceDays: 14 } }. Run `calm doctor` to see the plan.
